# Wan2.1's requirements.txt only gives lower bounds, so a fresh install picks up packages released
# after the paper. diffusers >= 0.35 calls torch.accelerator (torch >= 2.6) and breaks the torch 2.5.1
# runtime the paper used. These are the versions of the environment the artifact was validated with.
